posts.text: Pete Hegseth tries to pray during an event at the Pentagon. The only problem? He recited a monologue from Pulp Fiction, and not a prayer from the Bible.
Everything Donald Trump does is strategic, says @𝕻𝖆𝖙𝖗𝖎𝖔𝖙𝕯𝖆𝖉ᵉᵛ3.0  So the sacrilegious image he posted was also strategic?

Does Virginia HB965 strip Virginia citizens of their constitutional right to vote for the president? Quite the contrary.  VA HB965 is a so-called interstate compact designed to allow the President to be selected by popular vote and not by electoral college vote.  It won’t go into effect until and unless enough states pass a similar law to make up 270 electoral votes.

An ad running ties Virginia’s redistricting referendum to civil rights. The truth is that the ad was funded by dark money groups who are tied to other national efforts to disenfranchise working class voters in favor of special interest groups.  Let’s follow the money trail.

As April 15, the deadline to file America’s income tax return, approaches, millions of Americans have to use services from private companies like intuit TurboTax and H&R Block, now that the government has ended the free tax filing program #incometax #trumpadministration

The White House and the Pentagon’s top general are urging Congress to renew Section 702 of FISA (the foreign international surveillance act) which allows warrantless surveillance.  Sec. 702 of FISA has been tied to thousands of FBI searches for communications by journalists, activists and politicians in the USA, who shouldn’t be in the FISA database.

Donald Trump shared an image of himself appearing as Jesus and healing a person while holding a beam of light.  Many reacted in disdain, but just as many say their support of Trump has not changed, even if this has happened.

A federal judge in Florida dismissed the $10 billion defamation lawsuit filed by Trump against the WSJ, Murdoch, Dow Chemicals and others for the article about Trump’s bawdy birthday card written to Epstein  The Court said that the plaintiff was not able to prove actual malice.

Did NYC mayor Zohran Mamdani issue an order barring people from the city’s celebration for the 250th Annivesary in New York City on July 4? No. Unlike people like @🇺🇸Jenn🇺🇸 say, that’s not what the order is about.
So… teen pregnancy is down 7% since last year and 70% in the last 20 years… and FoxNews and conservative pundits are complaining about it
